prose: Chip stocks fell on Tuesday after Broadcom's boss compared many AI investors to casino gamblers, and Chinese memory maker CXMT said it had made good progress on a new DRAM architecture that boosts density. South Korea's Kospi dropped 6.25%, Japan's Nikkei fell 1.8%, Taiwan about 2% with TSMC similar, and Samsung Electronics fell 7.4%. Basis: the opening of the Guardian's live report.
highlights: Broadcom's CEO likened AI investing to a casino.
CXMT claims progress on a denser DRAM architecture, pressuring Samsung.
Samsung down 7.4%, TSMC and Nikkei also lower.
